message.content:
This editorial illustration shows a stylized nighttime cityscape in shades of blue, purple, and red. Tall, rectangular skyscrapers with illuminated square windows rise against a dark purple sky with horizontal clouds. Below, a dark surface creates a horizontal reflection of the skyline. The word "TEMPO" in large blue capital letters dominates the upper third, with "50 Tahun!" written in cursive script below it. 

On the left, large white text reads "UP DULU, GAN" followed by a paragraph in smaller white font beginning "Dalam kondisi merugi..." and ending "...untuk publik?". Two red rectangular signs with rounded edges appear on the right. The top sign contains the white word "Bukalapak", while the bottom sign, reflected in the water, contains the distorted text "BnKgUrgpg". 

At the top, two phrases are separated by a diagonal line: "MUSABAB OBAT TERAPI COVID-19 LANGKA" and "PERAIH MEDALI PERTAMA OLIMPIADE TOKYO". The bottom features a barcode, a QR code, and publication details including the date "2-8 AGUSTUS 2021", the price "RP 45.000", and the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO". A solid red border frames the left and bottom edges of the composition.
